            "const String kBuildGitCommit = '${GIT_COMMIT}';" \
            "const String kBuildGitBranch = '${GIT_BRANCH}';" \
            "const String kBuildSubmodules = '${SUBMODULES}';" \
            > lib/core/services/build_info.dart

          echo "Build info generated:"
          cat lib/core/services/build_info.dart

      - name: Cache vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework
          key: wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0
      - name: Restore vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The prebuilt XCFramework is excluded from git. Order of preference:
          # 1) actions/cache hit (keyed by the release tag) — warm until the
          #    repo's daily cache churn LRU-evicts the entry (saved 10-20
          #    06:02Z, gone by 10-21 19:03Z: gh-1759 ran cold twice);
          # 2) local working copy on this self-hosted runner;
          # 3) upstream release asset — the curl budget MUST fit the step
          #    cap WITH CORRECT ARITHMETIC (gh-1149): retries live in THIS
          #    bash loop, not curl --retry (which adds N MORE attempts AND
          #    restarts+truncates instead of resuming). Worst case with the
          #    gh-1759 budget: 4 × 240s max-time + 3 × 5s sleeps = 975s,
          #    + connect + unzip + slack ≈ 1035s < the 20-min (1200s) cap.
          #
          #    gh-1759: the gh-1149 budget (3 × 240s) was sized for this
          #    link's good-day ~300KB/s. The 10-21 daily run measured
          #    40–108KB/s (cold cache, both arch jobs): 3 × 240s banked
          #    only 29.5MB (x86_64) / 73% (arm64) of the 97,238,501-byte
          #    asset and the leg went red. Resume worked (`Resuming
          #    transfer from byte position …` in the logs) — the wire
          #    budget was simply too small, and the old pre-loop wipe
          #    threw each run's partial away, so a slow-link day never
          #    banked durable progress and the leg could not self-heal.
          #    Fixes: (a) the per-arch /tmp partial now PERSISTS across
          #    runs — -C - resumes it within the step AND across daily
          #    runs (macOS prunes only 3-day-untouched /tmp files; a daily
          #    run touches it) until the asset completes and the
          #    actions/cache post-step saves the framework; (b) the loop
          #    grew to 4 × 240s under a 20-min step cap.
          LOCAL_SRC="/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/flutter_agent/vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"
          DEST="vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks"
          # PER-ARCH zip path: both matrix archs run on ONE self-hosted
          # runner (the shared-state race this file already guards with
          # per-arch keychains below) — a shared arch-less /tmp zip would
          # let one job's cleanup unlink the other's in-flight partial,
          # then both curls interleave bytes into one path.
          ZIP="/tmp/WasmRun.xcframework-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip"
          # The release asset is immutable per tag — pin its digest so a
          # wrong-content-but-valid-zip cannot slip past unzip CRC32 into
          # the permanent wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0 cache (same pattern
          # as the litertlm download above). The pinned byte size tells a
          # truncated download (KEEP the partial — the next run resumes
          # it) apart from a complete-but-wrong one (PURGE and restart).
          ASSET_DIGEST="aca903d732202bcdf9c8d19fbb8a795c3c930762419f852a5ee228468c548a98"
          ASSET_BYTES=97238501
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          if [ -f "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework/Info.plist" ]; then
            echo "Using framework already in place (actions/cache hit or valid leftover)"
          elif [ -d "$LOCAL_SRC" ]; then
            echo "Using local framework: $LOCAL_SRC"
            cp -R "$LOCAL_SRC" "$DEST/"
          else
            echo "No cache, no local copy — downloading from upstream release..."
            # The partial is deliberately NOT deleted between runs
            # (gh-1759): it is exactly what -C - is for. If the persisted
            # zip is already complete AND digest-valid, skip the download
            # — a -C - attempt against a complete file gets HTTP 416 and
            # reads success as failure.
            if [ -f "$ZIP" ] && echo "$ASSET_DIGEST  $ZIP" | shasum -a 256 -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Complete, digest-valid $ZIP persisted from an earlier run — skipping download"
            else
              for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
                # --fail: without it curl exits 0 on HTTP 404/5xx and writes
                # the error page into the zip; with it every HTTP error
                # engages this loop's retries. -C - makes each attempt
                # RESUME the partial zip (Range requests), so slow links
                # make forward progress within this step AND across runs.
                if curl --fail -L -C - --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 240 \
                  -o "$ZIP" \
                  https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run/releases/download/wasm_run-v0.1.0/WasmRun.xcframework.zip; then
                  break
                fi
                if [ "$attempt" = "4" ]; then
                  echo "download attempt $attempt failed — out of loop attempts" >&2
                else
                  echo "download attempt $attempt failed, resuming in 5s..."
                  sleep 5
                fi
              done
              got=$(wc -c < "$ZIP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || echo 0)
              if [ "$got" -eq "$ASSET_BYTES" ] && echo "$ASSET_DIGEST  $ZIP" | shasum -a 256 -c -; then
                : # complete and authentic — fall through to unzip
              elif [ "$got" -lt "$ASSET_BYTES" ]; then
                echo "WasmRun.xcframework.zip incomplete: $got / $ASSET_BYTES bytes after $attempt attempts — keeping the partial; the next run resumes from byte $got (gh-1759)" >&2
                exit 1
              else
                echo "WasmRun.xcframework.zip is $got bytes (expected $ASSET_BYTES) or failed its pinned sha256 — purging it so the next run restarts clean" >&2
                rm -f "$ZIP"
                exit 1
              fi
            fi
            unzip -q "$ZIP" -d "$DEST"
          fi
          ls -la "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"

      # Per-arch keychain: both matrix archs build on ONE self-hosted
      # runner; a shared build.keychain raced (one job's delete+create
      # emptied it under the other's codesign — errSecInternalComponent /
      # "No certificate found", builds 86).
      - name: Import macOS signing certificate
        id: signing
        env:
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  No signing certificate found — building unsigned (development only)"
            echo "signed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "✅ Signing certificate found — importing..."
            security delete-keychain build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
            security create-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            # gh-1798: the window must cover the WHOLE job, not the
            # import→build gap. On the first Xcode 27 run the tool's
            # "Adding Swift Package Manager integration" pass alone took
            # 3365s (56 min) + 443s pod install, putting the first codesign
            # evaluation 73+ min after unlock — the 1h window auto-locked
            # the keychain mid-build and codesign lost the identity
            # ("No certificate for team ... matching ... found"). 4h ≥ the
            # 150-min job ceiling with slack. Pinned by
            # test/ci_macos_signing_window_guard_test.dart.
            security set-keychain-settings -t 14400 -u build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db

            echo "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
            security import certificate.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
              -P "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" \
              -T /usr/bin/codesign \
              -T /usr/bin/productbuild
            security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            echo "signed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

          if [ -n "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > profile.provisionprofile
            echo "profile_embedded=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

            # Make the profile visible to Xcode manual signing.
            PROFILE_UUID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract UUID raw -)
            PROFILE_NAME=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Name raw -)
            PROFILE_TEAM=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract TeamIdentifier.0 raw - 2>/dev/null || true)
            echo "Profile: $PROFILE_NAME / UUID: $PROFILE_UUID / team: $PROFILE_TEAM"
            mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles"
            cp profile.provisionprofile "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles/${PROFILE_UUID}.provisionprofile"
            echo "profile_uuid=$PROFILE_UUID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "profile_team=$PROFILE_TEAM" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "⚠️  No provisioning profile found — TestFlight will warn"
            echo "profile_embedded=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Build macOS release (${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          echo "Building for architecture: $ARCH"
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -n "${MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual
            if [ -n "${MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID"
            elif [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
            fi
            if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
            fi
          else
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic
          fi
          # gh-180 REG gate — fail loud at build time, not at release time.
          # --config-only drives the tool's real SPM/pods config pass
          # (migration or its clean skip + pod install) without compiling;
          # the gate then asserts the lane invariants: app floor 14.0
          # (pbxproj + Podfile), the vendored inappwebview Package.swift
          # stays deleted, and NO SwiftPM state exists after the config
          # pass. If the FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER=0 pin above ever
          # loses (env name change, tool default flip, a plugin regaining
          # Package.swift), this fails in seconds with the remediation
          # instead of Xcode's cryptic "requires minimum platform version"
          # error after a 50+-minute resolution pass (gh-1798 measured
          # 3365s on the first Xcode 27 run).
          # gh-1800 follow-up: self-hosted workdirs are PERSISTENT — SPM
          # state generated by pre-pin builds (untracked: macos/Flutter/
          # ephemeral SPM package refs, Pods, .symlinks) survives
          # actions/checkout, and the config-only pass below re-adopts it
          # (observed: "Adding Swift Package Manager integration… 1095s"
          # + gate failure on run 39991663029, both arch legs). The
          # FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER=0 pin IS honored by Flutter
          # 3.47.x on a clean tree (verified locally: zero SPM state
          # after clean + config-only), so the deterministic fix is to
          # remove the residue before every build.
          flutter clean
          rm -rf macos/Flutter/ephemeral macos/Pods macos/.symlinks
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" flutter build macos --config-only
          bash ../scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh 14.0
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" flutter build macos --release \
            --build-name=$BUILD_VERSION \
            --build-number=$BUILD_NUMBER
          MAIN_BIN=$(find build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app -name "Fa" -type f | head -1)
          echo "=== Binary architecture verification ==="
          echo "Binary path: $MAIN_BIN"
          file "$MAIN_BIN"
          lipo -info "$MAIN_BIN"
          echo "=== End binary verification ==="
          # The Dart side resolves the wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on the
          # main executable. If the symbols were dead-stripped or not exported
          # the app boots to a white screen on TestFlight — fail here instead.
          echo "=== wasm_run FFI symbol verification ==="
          # dyld_info reads the exports trie, which survives stripping
          # (nm -gD fails on stripped binaries with "no dynamic symbol table").
          EXPORTS=$(xcrun dyld_info -exports "$MAIN_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true)
          WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh — the same call
          # runs on the no-sandbox build and every web packaging surface):
          # fails loudly if the flutter_assets layout drifts instead of
          # silently shipping the fat bundle. Re-enable path (review,
          # #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode ever ships
          # (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), reseed assets/wasm — until then a
          # desktop wasm load would fail as a missing asset, not a
          # #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh "$ASSETS" \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil
              # -insert/-replace treats dots as nested key separators).
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.application-identifier string $APP_ID" entitlements.plist
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.developer.team-identifier string $TEAM_ID" entitlements.plist
              # The profile may not grant every *capability* the app declares
              # (e.g. homekit needs a separate App ID capability in the
              # Developer Portal). TestFlight rejects capability entitlements
              # the profile doesn't include ('Invalid Code Signing
              # Entitlements', error 90285).
              #
              # Only com.apple.developer.* keys are profile-gated. The
              # com.apple.security.* sandbox entitlements (network, files,
              # personal-information) are NOT in the profile by design — any
              # sandboxed app may declare them — so they must survive.
              #
              # NOTE: `plutil -extract ... -o -` (stdout form) is not
              # supported on every macOS the runner may have; use real temp
              # files so the extraction can't silently produce nothing.
              security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile -o profile_decoded.plist
              plutil -extract Entitlements json profile_decoded.plist -o profile_ents.json
              for KEY in $(plutil -convert xml1 entitlements.plist -o - | grep -o '<key>[^<]*</key>' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); do
                case "$KEY" in
                  com.apple.application-identifier|com.apple.developer.team-identifier) continue ;;
                  com.apple.developer.*) ;;
                  *) continue ;; # sandbox + misc entitlements are not profile-gated
                esac
                if ! python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('profile_ents.json')); raise SystemExit(0 if '$KEY' in d else 1)"; then
                  echo "Dropping capability not granted by profile: $KEY"
                  /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Delete :$KEY" entitlements.plist
                fi
              done
              ENTITLEMENTS="entitlements.plist"
            else
              ENTITLEMENTS="flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements"
            fi

            codesign_app() {
              codesign --force --deep --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                --entitlements "$ENTITLEMENTS" \
                "$APP_PATH"
            }

            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              if codesign_app; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "5" ]; then
                echo "codesign failed after $attempt attempts"
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep_seconds=$((attempt * 30))
              echo "codesign failed, retrying in ${sleep_seconds}s (attempt $attempt/5)..."
              sleep "$sleep_seconds"
            done

            echo "Verifying code signature..."
            codesign -vv --deep --strict "$APP_PATH"
            spctl -a -vv "$APP_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
          fi

          DMG_STAGING="dmg-staging"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"
          mkdir "$DMG_STAGING"
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" "$DMG_STAGING/"
          ln -s /Applications "$DMG_STAGING/Applications"

          TMP_DMG="tmp-fa.dmg"
          hdiutil create \
            -volname "Fa $VERSION" \
            -srcfolder "$DMG_STAGING" \
            -ov \
            -format UDRW \
            "$TMP_DMG"

          hdiutil convert "$TMP_DMG" -format UDZO -o "$DMG_NAME"
          rm -f "$TMP_DMG"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"

          echo "dmg_name=$DMG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          ZIP_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}-mac.zip"
          echo "Packaging ZIP for auto-update: $ZIP_NAME"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_NAME"
          SHA512=$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "$ZIP_NAME" | openssl base64 -A)
          SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$ZIP_NAME")
          MANIFEST_ARCH="$ARCH"
          if [ "$MANIFEST_ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
            MANIFEST_ARCH="x64"
          fi
          MANIFEST_NAME="latest-mac-${MANIFEST_ARCH}.yml"
          RELEASE_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
          printf '%s\n' \
            "version: ${VERSION}" \
            "files:" \
            "  - url: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "    sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "    size: ${SIZE}" \
            "    arch: ${MANIFEST_ARCH}" \
            "path: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "releaseDate: '${RELEASE_DATE}'" \
            > "$MANIFEST_NAME"
          echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "manifest_name=$MANIFEST_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "baseline_arch=$MANIFEST_ARCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate on
      # the shipped mac zip (auto-update channel). arm64 baseline is
      # committed, reseeded onto the post-cut shape (#1096 size diet: no
      # wasm_run_flutter.framework, no flutter_assets/assets/wasm, no
      # js_widget_runtime test assets — regrowth of any of those fails as
      # a NEW line > 5% of TOTAL); unknown archs FAIL — never self-seed
      # green.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (mac zip)
        run: |
          case "${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}" in
            arm64|x64) ;;
            *) echo "::error::mac arch '${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}' has no size baseline mapping — add scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-<arch>.tsv and extend this whitelist" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check "${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}" \
            --baseline "scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}.tsv" --init-if-missing

      # A self-seeded baseline (e.g. first x86_64 release) lands only in
      # this job's ephemeral workspace — upload it so it can be fetched
      # and committed to arm that arch's gate (same as pages.yml).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines-macos
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Package TestFlight PKG (arm64)
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        id: testflight_pkg
        env:
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Mac Installer Distribution cert not configured — skipping TestFlight PKG (the DMG path is unaffected)."
            exit 0
          fi
          # The installer cert goes into the same build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain (it exists
          # from the signing step when SIGNED=true; create it otherwise).
          KEYCHAIN_PASS="${MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD:-}"
          if ! security list-keychains | grep -q build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain; then
            # create-keychain fails with "already exists" when the keychain
            # exists but is not in the search list (grep above missed it) —
            # tolerate that and just add it to the search list.
            security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain || true
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
          fi
          echo "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > installer.p12
          security import installer.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
            -P "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD" \
            -T /usr/bin/productbuild -T /usr/bin/xcodebuild
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
          rm -f installer.p12

          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          PKG_NAME="fa-macos-arm64-${VERSION}.pkg"
          echo "Building TestFlight package: $APP_PATH → $PKG_NAME"
          productbuild --component "$APP_PATH" /Applications "$PKG_NAME" \
            --sign "$MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID"
          echo "pkg_name=$PKG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Notarize DMG
        if: steps.signing.outputs.signed == 'true'
        env:
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD }}
          DMG_NAME: ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  Notarization secrets not set — skipping notarization"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Submitting for notarization..."
          xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG_NAME" \
            --apple-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" \
            --team-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID" \
            --password "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD" \
            --wait
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG_NAME"
          echo "✅ Notarization complete"

      - name: Submit PKG to TestFlight
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_PKG_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          # External TestFlight distribution (issue #239): lanes fail
          # loudly when these are unset — set them once as repo variables.
          TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP: ${{ vars.TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP }}
          BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE }}
          # gh-1522: the ASC/TestFlight version string rides the derived tag
          # version (store_pubspec_version prefers BUILD_NAME; the committed
          # pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder).
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::App Store Connect API key not configured — skipping TestFlight upload (the PKG stays in artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          bundle install
          bundle exec fastlane mac submit_only

      - name: Upload TestFlight PKG artifact
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-macos-testflight-pkg
          path: ${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: Fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.manifest_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Build and package no-sandbox release
        id: package_nosandbox
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -z "${FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:-}" ] && [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
            export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
          fi
          if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
          fi
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" ./scripts/build_macos_nosandbox.sh
          APP_PATH="build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          NO_DMG="fa-macos-nosandbox-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"
          NO_DMGTMP="tmp-fa-nosandbox.dmg"
          # Same size diet as the sandboxed DMG above (review, #1096): the
          # fresh no-sandbox build carries the full flutter_assets — prune
          # before any packaging so DMG and ZIP both ship lean.
          bash ../scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh \
            "build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets" \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test
          rm -rf dmg-staging-nosandbox
          mkdir dmg-staging-nosandbox
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" dmg-staging-nosandbox/
          ln -s /Applications dmg-staging-nosandbox/Applications
          hdiutil create \
            -volname "Fa $VERSION (no sandbox)" \
            -srcfolder dmg-staging-nosandbox \
            -ov \
            -format UDRW \
            "$NO_DMGTMP"
          hdiutil convert "$NO_DMGTMP" -format UDZO -o "$NO_DMG"
          rm -f "$NO_DMGTMP"
          rm -rf dmg-staging-nosandbox
          NO_ZIP="fa-macos-nosandbox-${ARCH}-${VERSION}-mac.zip"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$NO_ZIP"
          echo "dmg_name=$NO_DMG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "zip_name=$NO_ZIP" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload no-sandbox macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: Fa-macos-nosandbox-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            flutter_app/${{ steps.package_nosandbox.outputs.dmg_name }}
            flutter_app/${{ steps.package_nosandbox.outputs.zip_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Cleanup keychain
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
          rm -f certificate.p12 installer.p12

  build-macos-cli:
    name: Build macOS CLI ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351): dart
    # CLI bundle + release upload; the two arches run in PARALLEL on
    # GitHub-hosted runners (they do not serialize like the self-hosted
    # build-macos matrix does).
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: macos-latest
            arch: arm64
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            arch: x64
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Blobless full history: the lazy draft create (gh-1801 rework)
          # builds the release body via scripts/release_notes.sh — same
          # reason as release-macos's checkout (gh-1477: the notes read
          # commit MESSAGES, never historical file blobs).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Build CLI bundle
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=build/out
          mv build/out/bundle/bin/fah build/out/bundle/bin/fa
          chmod +x build/out/bundle/bin/fa
          echo "$version" > build/out/bundle/version.txt

      - name: Ad-hoc sign CLI binary
        run: |
          codesign --force --sign - build/out/bundle/bin/fa

      - name: Archive and upload CLI bundle
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          # Matrix legs share GITHUB_JOB=build-macos-cli — the leg-suffixed
          # draft owner identity keeps the guard below scoped to the leg
          # that created the draft, never the sibling's mid-upload one.
          RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY: run/${{ github.run_id }}/job/${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz"
          tar -czf "$asset" -C build/out bundle
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # gh-1801 (rework): DRAFT-first, publish is PROVENANCE-OWNED.
          # The CLI tarball is a `fa update` asset, but servability needs
          # the SIGNED SHA256SUMS — which only the tag-run's
          # release-provenance job uploads (ci.yml). So: create the draft
          # lazily (curated notes via release_notes.sh + THIS leg's
          # draft-owner marker the guard below can reclaim), upload, and
          # let provenance own the --draft=false --latest flip.
          bash scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      # Leg-scoped (gh-1801): matches only THIS arch leg's marker.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_DRAFT_IDENTITY: run/${{ github.run_id }}/job/${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Blobless full history: the lazy draft create (gh-1801 rework)
          # builds the release body via scripts/release_notes.sh — same
          # reason as release-macos's checkout (gh-1477).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # gh-1684 decision 4 (gate symmetry): the SAME exact patch pin
          # the pages.yml leg carried and the PR gate carries (#1431 —
          # the rev normalization absorbs canvaskit rev-hash churn, the
          # pin keeps every fa-extension.zip build comparable across
          # legs). The old unpinned `channel: stable` floated the engine
          # per run — one of the two ways the release and Pages legs
          # diverged.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed baseline (gh-1684: reseeded to the
      # post-#1631 vendored-engines shape — litert/transformers/webllm are
      # intentional CWS policy; growth beyond the floor fails the release).
      # Identical invocation as the PR-time gate (ci.yml
      # extension-size-gate): one baseline, one enforcement rule.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # gh-1801 (rework): DRAFT-first, NEVER publish here. The
          # extension zip is not a `fa update` asset — and even a CLI
          # asset alone would not make the release servable: the SIGNED
          # SHA256SUMS only lands in the tag-run's release-provenance job,
          # which owns the --draft=false --latest flip. Create the draft
          # with the curated notes + the draft-owner marker (so the guard
          # step below can reclaim it on failure) and upload.
          bash scripts/release_lazy_draft.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Full history: release_notes.sh falls back to "commits since the
          # previous tag" when the CHANGELOG has no section for this version.
          # gh-1477: blobless — the notes read commit MESSAGES, never
          # historical file blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Download DMG artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: dmgs
          pattern: Fa-macos-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: List downloaded artifacts
        run: ls -laR dmgs/

      - name: Merge macOS auto-update manifest
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --user pyyaml
          chmod +x scripts/merge-mac-update-manifest.sh
          scripts/merge-mac-update-manifest.sh dmgs dmgs/latest-mac.yml
          cat dmgs/latest-mac.yml

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # PAT (not the job token) so the tag push fires tag CI — the
          # attach-or-create script builds its push URL only when GH_TOKEN
          # is set; without it `git push ""` died with "fatal: bad
          # repository ''" (2026-10-22 v1.0.626 mobile leg).
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          DMGS=$(ls dmgs/*.dmg 2>/dev/null || true)
          ZIPS=$(ls dmgs/*-mac.zip 2>/dev/null || true)
          MANIFEST="dmgs/latest-mac.yml"
          echo "DMGs to upload: $DMGS"
          echo "ZIPs to upload: $ZIPS"

          STABLE_COPIES=()
          for zip in $ZIPS; do
            base=$(basename "$zip")
            # Skip no-sandbox zips from the auto-update stable names; the
            # sandboxed build is the default update feed.
            if [[ "$base" == *nosandbox* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            if [[ "$base" == *arm64* ]]; then
              cp "$zip" "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64-mac.zip"
              STABLE_COPIES+=("dmgs/fa-macos-arm64-mac.zip")
            elif [[ "$base" == *x86_64* ]]; then
              cp "$zip" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64-mac.zip"
              STABLE_COPIES+=("dmgs/fa-macos-x64-mac.zip")
            fi
          done

          # Extract the raw binary from the .app bundle and upload it as the
          # plain asset name (fa-macos-arm64 / fa-macos-x64) so `fa update`
          # and direct downloads work without knowing the version suffix.
          for zip in $ZIPS; do
            base=$(basename "$zip")
            if [[ "$base" == *nosandbox* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            unzip -qo "$zip" -d /tmp/fa-extract >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            BIN="/tmp/fa-extract/Fa.app/Contents/MacOS/Fa"
            if [ -f "$BIN" ]; then
              if [[ "$base" == *arm64* ]]; then
                cp "$BIN" "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64"
                ASSETS+=("dmgs/fa-macos-arm64")
              elif [[ "$base" == *x86_64* ]]; then
                cp "$BIN" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64"
                ASSETS+=("dmgs/fa-macos-x64")
              fi
              chmod +x "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64" 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
            rm -rf /tmp/fa-extract
          done
          ASSETS=($DMGS $ZIPS $MANIFEST "${STABLE_COPIES[@]}")

          # Notes come from the CHANGELOG section for this version, with a
          # conventional-commit fallback (issue #282: no more filler
          # bodies); the install hints stay as a footer.
          bash scripts/release_notes.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" > release-notes.md || true
          printf '\n## Installation\n- **macOS**: Download the DMG for your architecture (`arm64` for Apple Silicon, `x86_64` for Intel) and drag Fa.app to Applications. In-app updates use the ZIP + latest-mac.yml feed.\n- **Linux**: Download tar.gz, extract and run the `bundle/fa` binary.\n- **Windows**: Download zip, extract and run the `fa.exe`.\n' >> release-notes.md

          # Attach-or-create (issue #282 E3 + review of #294): idempotent
          # against the view->create race - a lost race uploads into the
          # winner's release instead of failing - and the create stamps an
          # ownership marker into the draft body, so the guard step below
          # only ever deletes THIS job's draft, never the mobile leg's
          # mid-upload draft on the same derived tag.
          bash scripts/release_attach_or_create.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" "${ASSETS[@]}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): the create above uploads
      # assets through a draft — a failed/cancelled run must delete it,
      # never orphan it (the v0.1.190 rot). Ownership-scoped (review of
      # #294): the guard deletes only a draft whose body carries THIS
      # run+job's marker — a sibling leg's draft is never touched.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

name: Build macOS Release (Fa)

# Issue #343: the daily-publish CLI leg and a human can dispatch this
# workflow in the same window; the run-name embeds the input so the
# watcher's displayTitle match (the only distinguisher in the run-list
# API) never adopts someone else's run.
run-name: "build-macos (create_release=${{ inputs.create_release }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.0.2) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      create_release:
        description: 'Create GitHub Release'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'

# Release builds are never preempted (issue #194 pt 5, same principle as
# ci.yml: tag/release runs must not be cancelled mid-flight; gh-1537
# retired the post-merge main ci run).
concurrency:
  group: Build macOS Release (Fa)-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — release-attaching jobs grant
# contents: write in their own job-level blocks.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351)
    # has a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default. gh-1477:
    # 10m was a time bomb — the full-history fetch outgrew its twin in
    # build-mobile (run 38027695551). 20m + the blobless filter below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: this job reads ONLY `git tag` — a full clone transfers
          # every blob ever written and the repo grows daily, so the fetch
          # outgrew the old 10m ceiling (run 38027695551). Blobless keeps
          # full tag/commit metadata without the blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.0.1"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"

    name: Build macOS ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version

    # unique registration label — the generic [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # list also matched the Linux self-hosted box's labels (same routing
    # bug that sent the build-mobile iOS jobs to Linux, gh-1600).

    # default 90 min) + a ~1-min one-shot appearance probe AFTER the
    # build/notarize work (gh-1041: the blocking distribution wait moved to
    # the deferred store-appearance-check workflow) — the job ceiling must
    # cover the worst case, not just the build.

      fail-fast: false

    env:

      # ships the Swift Package Manager feature enabled BY DEFAULT, migrates
      # a fresh clone at build time, and generates
      # FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage at the macOS 12.0 floor, raising
      # it to the app's 14.0 only via a best-effort, silent
      # `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` read. On the first Xcode 27 run that
      # read skipped (run 39905803673) and a 14.0-floored SwiftPM product
      # hard-failed both arches: "requires minimum platform version 14.0
      # ... but this target supports a lower version" → no DMGs in v1.0.630.
      # The env override is read per flutter invocation
      # (flutter_features_config.dart); with the feature off the SPM
      # migration skips cleanly and every macOS plugin builds from the
      # Podfile.lock pins at the Podfile platform (:osx, '14.0') — no
      # dependency on the fragile bump. Enforced at build time by
      # scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh (see the Build macOS release
      # step); pinned by test/build_macos_spm_lane_guard_test.dart +
      # test/macos_min_platform_gate_test.dart.
      #
      # Shelf life (gh-180 review): upstream is deprecating the disable
      # path — features.dart carries warningMessageOnDisable ("Enabling
      # Swift Package Manager will be required in a future version of
      # Flutter") and flutter/flutter#193978 tracks removing the flag
      # entirely. When that lands, this pin stops working and the lane
      # decision needs a different mechanism (a tighter tool-version pin,
      # or migrating the generated package's floor control). The gate
      # below fails loud the day the pin loses — including the env name
      # removal itself, since any SwiftPM state after the config pass is
      # a gate failure — so the removal cannot arrive as a silent red leg.
      FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"

    steps:
      # ── Prepare persistent local git mirrors ────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1644: the old inline single-shot logic died on the first network
      # hiccup — the recreate fell through to a full `git clone --mirror`
      # whose ~1 h transfer ended in "error: 2931 bytes of body are still
      # expected" (run 38855793382, exit 128). The shared script retries the
      # fetch with VISIBLE stderr, aborts stalled attempts, and recreates
      # BLOBLESS (--filter=blob:none, the gh-1477 precedent) with retries and
      # partial-dir cleanup. Contract: scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh
      # gh-1665 review: this step runs BEFORE any checkout on persistent
      # self-hosted runners — the workspace may hold a pre-merge tree (or be
      # wiped), so the script is bootstrapped from the commit-pinned raw URL
      # (workflow_dispatch-only workflows ⇒ ${{ github.sha }} is always a
      # pushed commit) with the mirror copy as the no-network fallback.
      - name: Update local git mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          mkdir -p "$MIRROR_BASE"
          MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          SCRIPT="$RUNNER_TEMP/update_git_mirror.sh"
          RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/${{ github.sha }}/scripts/update_git_mirror.sh"
          if ! curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 "$RAW" -o "$SCRIPT" \
             || [ ! -s "$SCRIPT" ]; then
            echo "raw bootstrap failed — syncing the mirror and falling back to its copy" >&2
            # gh-1665 review (returned IMPORTANT): in the one-run-wide
            # first-post-merge window the persistent mirror is still a
            # PRE-MERGE tree. Cheap single-shot ensure (bounded resilience
            # stays owned by $SCRIPT below) so the extraction that follows
            # succeeds on any runner that can reach github.com at all —
            # raw.githubusercontent.com being down degrades to the
            # fallback instead of a red leg.
            if [ -d "$MIRROR" ] && git -C "$MIRROR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin || true
            else
              rm -rf "$MIRROR"
              git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR" || true
            fi
            BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$MIRROR" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)"
            git --git-dir="$MIRROR" show "$BRANCH:scripts/update_git_mirror.sh" > "$SCRIPT" \
              || { echo "::error::could not bootstrap update_git_mirror.sh (raw URL unreachable and mirror lacks the script)" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bash "$SCRIPT" \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git \
            "$MIRROR"

      # ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1600 AC2: hardened mirror-checkout — the bare `rm -rf
      # "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"` used to fail the whole checkout on stale
      # unremovable leftovers in the persistent shared workspace (bench
      # docker leftovers, jobs/fa-2.1-docker-cpu-14/). Log-and-prune clean +
      # clone-around-stub; the per-arch build cache is parked outside the
      # workspace before the clean and restored after the clone (best-effort:
      # a lost cache re-builds from scratch, it never fails the checkout).
      # INLINE (not a composite action) on purpose: local `uses: ./...`
      # actions resolve against $GITHUB_WORKSPACE at step time — on this box
      # that is the PREVIOUS run's tree, and this step IS the checkout.

        run: |

Raw log above."

platform :osx, '14.0'

# CocoaPods analytics sends network stats synchronously affecting flutter build latency.
ENV['COCOAPODS_DISABLE_STATS'] = 'true'

project 'Runner', {
  'Debug' => :debug,
  'Profile' => :release,
  'Release' => :release,
}

def flutter_root
  generated_xcode_build_settings_path = File.expand_path(File.join('..', 'Flutter', 'ephemeral', 'Flutter-Generated.xcconfig'), __FILE__)
  unless File.exist?(generated_xcode_build_settings_path)
    raise "#{generated_xcode_build_settings_path} must exist. If you're running pod install manually, make sure \"flutter pub get\" is executed first"
  end

  File.foreach(generated_xcode_build_settings_path) do |line|
    matches = line.match(/FLUTTER_ROOT\=(.*)/)
    return matches[1].strip if matches
  end
  raise "FLUTTER_ROOT not found in #{generated_xcode_build_settings_path}. Try deleting Flutter-Generated.xcconfig, then run \"flutter pub get\""
end

require File.expand_path(File.join('packages', 'flutter_tools', 'bin', 'podhelper'), flutter_root)

flutter_macos_podfile_setup

target 'Runner' do
  use_frameworks!

  flutter_install_all_macos_pods File.dirname(File.realpath(__FILE__))
  target 'RunnerTests' do
    inherit! :search_paths
  end
end

post_install do |installer|
  installer.pods_project.targets.each do |target|
    flutter_additional_macos_build_settings(target)
  end

  # flutter_gemma / LiteRT-LM: copy the Apple companion dylibs into the app
  # bundle as .framework bundles and patch LiteRtLm's load command so that
  # dlopen("LiteRtLm.framework/LiteRtLm") resolves GemmaModelConstraintProvider
  # at runtime. Without this macOS builds crash at first inference.
  installer.aggregate_targets.each do |aggregate_target|
    aggregate_target.user_targets.each do |user_target|
      next unless user_target.name == 'Runner'
      phase_name = '[flutter_gemma] Setup LiteRT-LM macOS'
      existing = user_target.shell_script_build_phases.find { |p| p.respond_to?(:name) && p.name == phase_name }
      phase = existing || user_target.new_shell_script_build_phase(phase_name)
      phase.input_paths = [
        '$(BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR)/$(PRODUCT_NAME).app/Contents/Frameworks/LiteRtLm.framework/Versions/A/LiteRtLm',
      ]
      phase.output_paths = ['$(DERIVED_FILE_DIR)/flutter_gemma_litertlm_macos.stamp']
      phase.shell_script = <<~SHELL
        set -e
        FRAMEWORKS="${BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR}/${PRODUCT_NAME}.app/Contents/Frameworks"
        if [ ! -d "${FRAMEWORKS}" ]; then
          exit 0
        fi
        for base in LiteRtMetalAccelerator LiteRtTopKMetalSampler GemmaModelConstraintProvider; do
          rm -f "${FRAMEWORKS}/lib${base}.dylib"
        done
        for candidate in \\
            "${HOME}/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64" \\
            "${PODS_ROOT}/../Flutter/ephemeral/.symlinks/plugins/flutter_gemma/native/litert_lm/prebuilt/macos_arm64" \\
            "${SRCROOT}/../../native/litert_lm/prebuilt/macos_arm64"; do
          if [ -f "${candidate}/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            PLUGIN_PREBUILT="${candidate}"
            break
          fi
        done
        if [ -z "${PLUGIN_PREBUILT:-}" ]; then
          echo "[flutter_gemma] ERROR: Could not find macOS companion dylibs"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "[flutter_gemma] Using companion dylibs from: ${PLUGIN_PREBUILT}"
        for base in GemmaModelConstraintProvider LiteRtMetalAccelerator LiteRtTopKMetalSampler; do
          src="${PLUGIN_PREBUILT}/lib${base}.dylib"
          if [ ! -f "${src}" ]; then
            echo "[flutter_gemma] WARNING: ${src} not found"
            continue
          fi
          fw_dir="${FRAMEWORKS}/${base}.framework"
          mkdir -p "${fw_dir}/Versions/A/Resources"
          cp "${src}" "${fw_dir}/Versions/A/${base}"
          install_name_tool -id "@rpath/${base}.framework/Versions/A/${base}" \\
            "${fw_dir}/Versions/A/${base}" 2>/dev/null || true
          (cd "${fw_dir}" && ln -sfh A Versions/Current && ln -sfh "Versions/Current/${base}" "${base}" && ln -sfh "Versions/Current/Resources" Resources)
          cat > "${fw_dir}/Versions/A/Resources/Info.plist" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>${base}</string>
  <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>dev.flutterberlin.flutter-gemma.${base}</string>
  <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>1</string>
  <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>1.0</string>
  <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>FMWK</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF
          codesign --force --sign - "${fw_dir}/Versions/A/${base}" 2>/dev/null || true
          echo "[flutter_gemma] copied ${base}.framework"
        done
        LITERTLM="${FRAMEWORKS}/LiteRtLm.framework/Versions/A/LiteRtLm"
        if [ -f "${LITERTLM}" ]; then
          install_name_tool -change \\
            @rpath/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib \\
            @rpath/GemmaModelConstraintProvider.framework/Versions/A/GemmaModelConstraintProvider \\
            "${LITERTLM}" 2>/dev/null || true
          codesign --force --sign - "${LITERTLM}" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
        mkdir -p "$(dirname "${SCRIPT_OUTPUT_FILE_0}")"
        touch "${SCRIPT_OUTPUT_FILE_0}"
      SHELL
    end
  end

  # wasm_run FFI symbols live in a static library inside WasmRun.xcframework.
  # They are referenced only from Dart via dlsym (DynamicLibrary.executable()),
  # so the linker never pulls them in: force_load alone is not enough because
  # DEAD_CODE_STRIPPING=YES (Release default) still discards the unreferenced
  # code, and dlsym only sees exported symbols. Exporting a symbol makes it
  # both dlsym-visible AND a dead-strip root, so export every C-ABI symbol the
  # Dart bindings look up (wire_*/new_*/drop_*/…), derived from the archive
  # itself so the list stays in sync with the vendored package. Without this
  # the Release/TestFlight binary boots to a white screen. SRCROOT is the
  # macos/ directory, so ../../ walks up to the repo root where vendor/ lives.
  macos_slice = '$(SRCROOT)/../../vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a'
  macos_archive = File.expand_path('../../vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a', __dir__)
  ffi_symbols = `nm -gU -arch arm64 #{macos_archive}`.lines
    .map(&:split)
    .select { |cols| %w[T D S].include?(cols[1]) && cols[2] }
    .map { |cols| cols[2] }
    .uniq
    .grep(/^_(wire|new|drop|free|get|store|init|inflate|share)_/)
    .sort
  raise "no wasm_run FFI symbols found in #{macos_archive}" if ffi_symbols.empty?
  export_flags = ffi_symbols.map { |s| "-Wl,-exported_symbol,#{s}" }
  installer.aggregate_targets.each do |aggregate_target|
    aggregate_target.user_project.targets.each do |target|
      next unless target.name == 'Runner'
      target.build_configurations.each do |config|
        # Archive/install builds run `strip` per STRIP_STYLE. The default
        # "all" removes the dyld exports trie entirely, which kills the
        # dlsym-based wasm_run lookups at runtime — TestFlight white screen.
        # "non-global" (strip -x) keeps the trie intact.
        config.build_settings['STRIP_STYLE'] = 'non-global'
        ldflags = Array(config.build_settings['OTHER_LDFLAGS'] || ['$(inherited)']).dup
        # Drop stale wasm_run flags from earlier pod installs.
        ldflags.reject! { |f| f == '-force_load' || f.include?('wasm_run_dart.a') || f.start_with?('-Wl,-exported_symbol,') }
        ldflags << "-Wl,-force_load,#{macos_slice}"
        # Debug must NOT get -exported_symbol flags: giving any flips ld
        # into "export only these" mode, which hides the JIT entry point
        # (main) from the debug host — abort_could_not_find_entry_point
        # at launch. Debug exports all globals by default, so dlsym finds
        # the wire_* symbols without any flags.
        ldflags.concat(export_flags) unless config.name == 'Debug'
        config.build_settings['OTHER_LDFLAGS'] = ldflags
      end
    end
    aggregate_target.user_project.save
  end
end

name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # gh-1736: the archive is picked per HOST arch — the arch-less
        # flutter_macos_<v>-stable.zip is the X64 build, and an x64 dart
        # cannot exec on this Apple-silicon runner ("Bad CPU type in
        # executable", exit 126). Both matrix legs run on this ONE host
        # and share the slot (the matrix arch only steers
        # FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS), so the slot's SDK must match uname -m.
        # Same resolution subosito/flutter-action performs from the
        # platform arch; the naming lives in the tested sdk_slot.py.
        HOST_ARCH="$(uname -m)"
        ARCHIVE="$(python3 "$SLOT" archive "$VER" "$HOST_ARCH")"
        echo "host arch $HOST_ARCH -> $ARCHIVE"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap. gh-1736
        # adds the arch half: a slot unpacked from a wrong-arch archive
        # (or unstamped, like the poisoned runner slot this fixes) is
        # pruned by ensure_arch and reinstalled from the right archive.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
            DECISION="INSTALL $VER"

CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1805): modifier chords no longer type their base letter into the
  composer while the slash menu is open — the vendored dart_tui decoder
  puts the base letter into the keystroke's `text` for control bytes
  (Ctrl+S → `ctrl+s` with text `s`), and the slash-menu edit cluster was
  the one insert surface missing the `_isCommandKeystroke` guard, so a
  chord pressed mid-menu poisoned the typed prefix (`/memory` landed as
  `/smemory`). Plain letters and Shift+letters still type and filter.
- feat(1515): ONE model-limits settings surface — the settings hub's
  standalone "Model parameters" row is retired and bare `/model-edit`
  (TUI) aliases into `/settings` → Model capabilities, pre-focused on the
  active model. The caps flow gains the model-edit preset ladders +
  Custom… free input for context window / max output (a preset pick

  are unchanged.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Both desktop DMG legs (build-macos.yml, runs 39991663029 / 40022900373) fail after `flutter build macos --config-only` because the min-platform gate `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` FORBIDS any SwiftPM state — and on the pinned Flutter 3.47.7 the SwiftPM state is unavoidable.

**Root cause**: Upstream removed the `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER` disable knob between 3.47.4 and 3.47.7 (flutter/flutter#193978 — the deprecation the gh-180 lane comment predicted). The job-level pin `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` (build-macos.yml:142 env block) is now a no-op: the `--config-only` pass always adds SwiftPM integration ("Adding Swift Package Manager integration… 139–1095s"), generating `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` plus the pbxproj marker. The gh-180 gate treats ANY SwiftPM state after the config pass as a lane violation and fails both arches — even though the failing runs show every floor is already correct (`generated floor: 14.0`, Runner pbxproj 3×14.0, Podfile `:osx, '14.0'`, vendored podspec 14.0). The lane decision ("pure CocoaPods, forbid SPM") lost its enabling mechanism; the guard is now the failure itself.

A/B proof from the ticket: 3.47.7 + pin + clean tree (runner) → SPM state; 3.47.4 + pin + clean tree (local) → zero SPM state. The #1813 fallback (pin the legs to 3.47.4, the last flag-honoring patch) is blocked operationally: the runners' ~60kB/s link cannot fetch the 3.47.4 SDK (run 40034163885 died in the download, bounded retries exhausted).

**Impact**: Every desktop DMG release leg on the fa-m5 runners fails at the gate seconds after the config pass — no DMG/ZIP artifacts, no macOS release, daily-publish desktop legs red. iOS/TestFlight lane unaffected.

**Fix approach** (owner ruling: the minimum macOS version may be raised; adopt the SPM lane):
1. Floor audit — the exact sub-14.0 target from the original gh-180 error was the generated `FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage` at its 12.0 tool default with a silently-skipped `xcodebuild -showBuildSettings` floor bump. On 3.47.7 the bump works (gate diagnostic: `generated floor: 14.0`), so every floor in the lane is already ≥ 14.0: pbxproj 3×14.0, Podfile 14.0, generated package 14.0, vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` podspec 14.0 (Package.swift stays deleted → the plugin rides CocoaPods on the hybrid SPM lane, pinned in Podfile.lock). No floor file needs raising — the gate must now ENFORCE these floors instead of forbidding SPM.
2. Rewrite `scripts/assert_macos_min_platform.sh` to ASSERT the SPM lane: SwiftPM state EXPECTED after the config pass (pbxproj marker + generated package), every discovered Package.swift floor within [APP_MIN, no product above the app min], generated floor ≥ APP_MIN (the silent bump must not skip — the exact gh-180 killer), vendored plugin Package.swift floor asserted if it ever reappears. Fail-loud-in-seconds contract unchanged.
3. Remove the dead `FLUTTER_SWIFT_PACKAGE_MANAGER: "0"` pin from the build-macos job env (it no longer disables anything and the comment lies about the lane) and update the release-step gate commentary.
4. Revert the #1813 SDK pin `3.47.4` → `3.47.7` in the same change.
5. Full local verification runs on Linux (gate unit suites + workflow-shape guards); end-to-end DMG legs are exercised by the runners' next build-macos dispatch.

**Previous attempt**: #1812 (SPM-residue clean before the config pass) — necessary hygiene, not sufficient: the failing run 40022900373 came AFTER the clean, so residue is excluded as the cause. #1813 (pin to 3.47.4) — merged but operationally dead: the runner network cannot download that SDK; and it only postpones the flag removal.
